app.name: ScummVM (diagnostic RPX)
app.coder: ScummVM Team; Wii U port by Rrhapsod
app.long_description: Diagnostic build, not a confirmed fix or stable release. Includes the October 9 engine set. Writes an append-only, synchronized scummvm-compat-diagnostic.log under SD:/scummvm. Logging may affect timing and performance. Back up configuration and saves; read TESTING.md before testing. Non-Aroma RPX operation remains unverified. No games or MT-32 ROMs included.
